messages:
maria: Quick sync — aiming to ship the metered slab calculator with a small nudge flow on launch next week. Need: final FAQ copy, legal signoff on the warning language, and inbound routing tag rules for leads that use the calculator. Who can take what?
ajay: I can wire the nudge variants into the calculator UI. Which nudges are we testing?
beth: Two quick ideas: 1) 'Popular for teams like yours' callout when calc suggests a committed slab, 2) inline saving estimate CTA for metered projections. Both short copy.
sam: Finance: make sure the calculator shows both per-token estimate and monthly slab estimate. Also we need a short legal-friendly line about variable usage. Propose: `Estimates shown are for planning only; actual billing is usage-based and subject to your contract.`
lia: I can review legal copy — share the exact phrasing we intend to surface near the estimate and in the FAQ. Prefer minimal liability language but not scary for PLG.
maria: Copy proposals below — please react with :thumbsup: to the line you'd approve, or suggest an edit. Also we need inbound tag routing: if user selects 'committed' show prefill lead as `tier_interest: committed`, else `tier_interest: metered`. Add a `calc_lead_score` when estimate > $5k/mo.
beth: Suggested FAQ snippet (short): "How accurate is this estimate?" — "This calculator provides planning estimates based on your inputs and typical usage patterns. Final billing is usage-based; contact Sales for committed slab pricing and discounts."
ajay: For the UI nudge variants: A) subtle badge: 'Recommended for steady usage' B) modal nudges after >45s on calc with 'save estimate & talk to Sales' CTA. Which should be default?
maria: Start with badge (A) default and run modal (B) as an experimental bump at 10% traffic. Keep modal copy light.
sam: Routing rules look good. Ops note: when `calc_lead_score` >= 1, add to sales queue 'pricing-calc-warm'. Also record `estimate_monthly_usd` as numeric.
ops-bot: deploy reminder — staging build with calc-nudge toggle is ready: `deploy staging --tag calc-nudge-experiment`. Please test and approve by EOD.
lia: Legal edits: change "contact Sales" -> "contact Redwood Sales" and add: "Offers and discounts require a separate agreement." Approve?
maria: Approved with that small tweak. Beth can you fold that into FAQ copy?
beth: Done — FAQ updated in notion (link: https://redwoodhq.notion/pricing/calc-faq). I added a one-line microcopy for the modal: "Save this estimate to get a tailored quote."
ajay: UX note: we need a tiny tooltip on the badge explaining why it's recommended (data-driven sentence). I'll add that today.
maria: Last ask: webinar CTA — if someone saves an estimate and selects 'learn more' route them to upcoming pricing webinar signup and tag inbound source `calc-webinar`. Sam — can we auto-attach a follow-up sequence?
sam: Yes — create follow-up sequence ID `calc_followup_v1`. Sales will get an initial email + 1-week reminder.
lia: One more legal check: ensure webinar signup copy includes opt-in language for marketing comms.
maria: Noted. Final action items: ajay implement badge + modal toggle, beth finalize FAQ & modal copy, sam wire routing + follow-up, lia legal signoff on the FAQ+webinar copy, everyone test staging before EOD. Thanks — I’ll run a 15-min sync at 3pm to confirm.
ops-bot: reminder scheduled: 15m sync at 15:00 today.
